ns2:section.sectionText: Interdisciplinary Research and Education in Biology, Engineering and Health Science. This course will introduce students to interdisciplinary education, research programs, and career opportunities in these fields, as well as educate and empower students to take leadership roles and address global cross-disciplinary challenges in our changed world. First Year Discovery Program Course. Registration restricted to freshman. Students should enroll in only one Discovery course.
ns2:section.sectionCappArea: Restricted to First Time Freshman students.
